changes.note: Stage changed from not_started to proposed (progress 0 to 5) and match from partial to parallel: a bipartisan-sponsored package (announced 2026-05-07) would move the Secret Service, FEMA and TSA out of DHS, though with different destinations and no reported advancement, and the 2025 closures of DHS oversight offices we
changes.title: Dismantle DHS into mission-based agencies, with one border and immigration agency

changes.note: Stage changed from blocked (30) to in_progress (40): the D.C. Circuit partly stayed the ruling in August 2025, so the asylum restriction was not fully blocked while on appeal, it then lost on the merits on 2026-04-24 with the mandate stayed since July 2026, and new sourcing shows operating asylum cooperative agreements
changes.title: Restrict border asylum; restart Remain in Mexico and third-country agreements

changes.note: Stage changed from in_progress (25) to proposed (15): fuller searches found no structural change, but Executive Order 14243 section 3(f) directs an over-classification policy review, a directed step toward the Mandate's tighter-definitions goal; record-specific releases are kept as parallel context.
changes.title: Modernize classification and declassification and cut original classification authorities

changes.note: Stage changed from blocked (40) to in_progress (50): the 2026-03-17 reinstatement order behind the blocked rating was stayed by a D.C. Circuit panel on 2026-03-31, State Department officials now lead the agency, and the 2026-07-30 Senate hearing and FY2026 appropriation were added.
changes.title: Restructure USAGM and VOA under tighter executive control or wind the agency down

changes.note: Replaces the pending placeholder: NIH banned funding of elective-abortion fetal tissue research (intramural and extramural) on 2026-01-22 and paused new embryonic stem cell registry additions on 2026-01-23, so the stage moves from pending to implemented.
changes.title: End NIH funding of abortion-derived fetal tissue and embryonic stem cell research

changes.note: The Medicaid and CHIP funding bar is not effective until 2026-10-13 and drew a 22-state suit, so only the Section 1557 half is operative today; stage moves from implemented 65 to in_progress 55 and should be rechecked after 2026-10-13.
changes.title: Reverse Section 1557 gender identity rule; end federal funding of youth gender transition

changes.note: Acreage is open and plan limits are removed, but the Montana sale bid was rejected, the Wyoming sale was postponed in October 2025, and no later sale or lease was found, so the item moves from implemented to in_progress.
changes.title: Restart federal coal leasing in Wyoming and Montana

changes.note: Stage moves from not_started to proposed (progress 5) because a 2026-07-22 DOT priorities letter reportedly asks Congress to consolidate some competitive grants; adds the House committee bill (2026-05-22) and the extension through 2026-12-11, and finds no move to formula funding.
changes.title: Replace DOT discretionary grants with formula distributions to the states

changes.note: Stage changes from not_started to proposed (progress 0 to 20) because H.R. 5396, which removes the employment goal from the Federal Reserve Act, was introduced 2025-09-16 and reported by the House Financial Services Committee on 2026-06-24, which the old record had not found.
changes.title: End the Fed's dual mandate and make price stability its sole statutory objective

changes.note: Stage changes from not_started to in_progress (0 to 30) because SBA announced on 2025-07-14 that it eliminated the religious exclusion for disaster loans, effective immediately, which the old record missed; Form 1971, a 530D notice and a formal rule remain unverified.
changes.title: Remove religious-entity exclusions from SBA loan programs and retire Form 1971

changes.note: Stage changes from not_started to in_progress (0 to 30) because a Chief Counsel was confirmed 2025-08-01 and is acting on Regulatory Flexibility Act compliance, EO 14219 and a regional program exist, and the FY2026 appendix and FY2027 request ask for roughly a 40 percent Advocacy increase; the old record's flat-budget
changes.title: Strengthen the Office of Advocacy's regulatory review role and budget

changes.note: Stage changed from not_started to proposed: two bills introduced in 2025 (S. 1651, H.R. 4032) would add edge providers to the USF contribution base, found through a CRS product and the bill texts.
changes.title: Require large online platforms to contribute to the Universal Service Fund

changes.note: Changed from pending to not_started: searches found no directive, DOJ defense or legislation, but did find that the FEC is being defaulted in court with no DOJ appearance and that DOJ's FECA-related actions (April 2025 memo, NRSC position) differ from the chapter.
changes.title: Limit DOJ prosecution to clear FECA violations and have DOJ defend the FEC in court

changes.note: Changed from pending to proposed: searches found the FEC lost its quorum in 2025, a commissioner was removed, and two Republican nominees were named on 2026-02-11 but not confirmed as of the latest sources.
changes.title: Keep the six-member, four-vote FEC structure and fill commissioner seats on time

changes.note: Changed from pending to in_progress: no task force found, but the FTC and DOJ backed the Texas v. BlackRock ESG antitrust suit and the FTC obtained consent orders against five large ad agencies over viewpoint-based ad-boycott coordination.
changes.title: Create an FTC task force on ESG and DEI collusion and unfair trade practices

changes.note: Changed from pending to in_progress: found the amended COPPA Rule (compliance 2026-04-22), a 6(b) study on AI chatbots and minors, the Sendit complaint with a Section 5 unfairness count, and 2026 age-verification steps; no contract-with-minors proceeding found.
changes.title: Use FTC unfair-practice authority to protect children from online platform contracts

changes.title: Extend consumer welfare beyond price in some cases and weigh a more active Big Tech stance

summary: Re-researched the 39 weakest objectives with fresh searches, ran a refutation check on the 56 objectives counted as in effect, audited links (all 197 Federal Register documents confirmed; 107 other links checked, none dead), and had an independent reviewer re-rate 61 changed records. 17 objectives changed status.
title: Validation pass: gap-fill research, red-team check, link audit
